message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “soft” card because it can be counted as either **1 or 11**—whichever gives your hand the best possible total without busting.  

- If counting the Ace as 11 keeps your total ≤ 21, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
- If adding 11 would bust, you treat it as 1.  

This flexibility also means that if you’re dealt a pair of Aces, you can split them into two separate hands (each starting with an Ace).
